'''Sumqayıt FK''' ({{langx|az|"Sumqayıt" futbol klubu}}, {{IPA|az|sumɡɑˈjɯt|pron|Az-Sumgayit.ogg}}) is an Azerbaijani professional [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Sumgayit|Sumgait]], that plays in the [[Azerbaijan Premier League]], the top tier of [[Football in Azerbaijan|football in the country]].<ref>{{cite web|title=FK Sumqayit|url=https://int.soccerway.com/teams/azerbaijan/fk-khazar-sumgayet/|work=Soccerway|publisher=Global Sports Media|access-date=17 February 2012}}</ref>"}}
